newsitem.title: USA: Church & Dwight sees Q3 EPS above estimates.
newsitem.headline: Church & Dwight sees Q3 EPS above estimates.

text.p: Church & Dwight Co Inc said Thursday its third quarter earnings per share will exceed analysts' estimates and will be about $0.25 per share.
First Call's consensus estimate for the quarter is $0.18 per share.
The company attributed the figures to strong sales of household and personal care products and said it expects the trend to continue through the fourth quarter.
The company reported earnings of $0.08 per share for the year-ago third quarter on sales of $120 million.
